_doc: DECLARED per-gate baseline max live-violation count for watched STRICT preflight gates. The strict-gate DRIFT ALARM (tac.preflight.check_strict_gate_violation_counts_within_declared_baseline + tools/audit_strict_gate_violation_drift.py) invokes each listed gate with strict=False and ALARMS when its live violation count EXCEEDS baseline_max. This is the committed baseline that lets INTENTIONAL non-zero backlogs be DECLARED (not spuriously alarmed) while a NEW regression above the declared count fires immediately. Purpose: close the Catalog #185 blind spot where a strict gate (canonical anchor: #344) silently drifted 0->480 with no alarm because #185 only invokes gates whose CLAUDE.md row literally self-claims 'live count: 0'. Burn a backlog down -> LOWER its baseline_max here (or run the tool with --update-baseline). Add every NEW watched strict gate here with baseline_max 0 (a gate that should be clean).
_alarm_semantics: live_count > baseline_max => OVER_BASELINE (alarm/violation). live_count == baseline_max => AT_BASELINE (ok). live_count < baseline_max => UNDER_BASELINE (advisory: backlog burned down, tighten this baseline). declared gate not a callable => MISSING_CALLABLE (config error: manifest is stale, a gate stopped being watched).

This is the canonical anchor for the whole alarm. Burn down (register equations or add FORMALIZATION_PENDING waivers) then LOWER baseline_max. Alarm fires the instant it grows past 480.
